## LogLevel variable

Logging level, with greater values representing more detailed logs emitted.

The zero value means no server logs will be emitted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
LogLevel: {
    NONE: number;
    ERROR: number;
    WARN: number;
    INFO: number;
    DEBUG: number;
}
```
